decision: Single prespecified model: completion_01 ~ wait_weeks + previous_no_shows + transportation_access
rationale: Agreed Chapter 05 scope supersedes the broader EDA roadmap; no stepwise/screening/interactions.

decision: completion_01 = 1 if appointment_completed == 'Yes'; transportation factor levels Yes (reference), No
rationale: Model describes odds of completion; reference group = patients with transportation access.
Coefficients interpretable per one additional week (7 days).

decision: patient_id, age, clinic_location and all post-visit variables excluded as predictors
rationale: Identifier; agreed scope; temporal leakage (followup, referral, health_improved, satisfaction, costs).

decision: Cleaned data used: 300 rows, 270 completed, 30 missed (RAW pre-deduplication count: 273 completed + 30 missed = 303)
rationale: 273 completed + 30 missed is the RAW (303-row, pre-deduplication) count; cleaned sample (N = 300) has 270 completed + 30 missed.

decision: No missing values in required model variables; complete-case N = 300
rationale: No patient removed because of unused-variable missingness; no new imputation.

decision: ~30 missed appointments for 3 predictor df treated as a caution about limited information
rationale: Not an iron law; penalization would not create information.

decision: Ordinary ML logistic regression retained as primary (No separation detected (infinite estimates: none); converged; finite SEs)
rationale: Firth not required by imbalance alone; used only as sensitivity comparison.

decision: Profile likelihood 95% CIs for ORs; Wald and LR p-values reported
rationale: Profile intervals behave better than Wald with few events.
Diagnostics are review tools, not deletion rules.

decision: Centered quadratic terms assessed separately as diagnostic sensitivity models; linear primary retained
rationale: Not selected by p-value; extra df is costly with 30 events.

decision: Excluded 4 recoded negative-wait records (Verified against raw file: IDs match log; cleaned value 0)
rationale: Zero wait was an assumption; other zero waits not excluded.
Robustness to questionable records; not an age test.
Different research comparison; not selected by p-value.

decision: Not applicable: no missing values in model variables
rationale: Global EDA complete-case N=269 involves unused variables.
Ordinary ML stable; Firth reported only for robustness.
Preferred over a single train/test split with 30 events.

decision: Teaching-only missed-risk cutoffs 0.10 and 0.20; not optimized
rationale: Workload and deployment decisions out of scope.

decision: Median imputation does not guarantee unbiased estimates; low events does not guarantee failure of larger models; nonsignificance is not absence
rationale: Overstatements in prior chapters corrected here; prior files left unchanged.
